meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把图片转成纯文本模型可读的结构化信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的AI只能处理文本，却需要理解用户发来的图片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn images into structured text evidence for text-only AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI handles text only but needs to understand user-submitted images.

howto.what: 装上后，当对话中出现图像而Claude无法直接看到内容时，它会调用modlens把图像转成结构化JSON（含逐字转录的文字、布局区域、语义、视觉线索），再据此回答。
howto.when: 当对话里出现带图片扩展名（.png、.jpg等）的文件路径或URL、粘贴图像占位符（如[Image #1]），且Claude看不到该图像内容时；或当你询问modlens的安装、配置、切换提供商时。

say.text: 这张图片里的文字是什么？
say.note: Claude会运行modlens并转录图中文字。

say.text: 用modlens分析这张图的布局和语义。
say.note: 返回布局区域与语义描述。
进入配置流程，按提示提供端点地址。

howto.what_en: When an image appears in the conversation and Claude cannot see it, it runs modlens to convert the image into structured JSON evidence (transcribed text, layout regions, semantics, visual clues) and answers from that.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, etc.) or a pasted-image placeholder appears and Claude cannot see the image content, and when you ask how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers.

say_en.text: What text is in this image?
say_en.note: Claude runs modlens and transcribes the text.

say_en.text: Analyze this image's layout and semantics with modlens.
say_en.note: Returns layout regions and semantic description.

say_en.text: Help me configure my OpenAI-compatible endpoint for modlens.
say_en.note: Starts the config flow, follow the prompts.
